case: The same five control fields, in reverse order.
why: Every check over this table is a per-row membership check; the order rows are written in changes no field's owner. A control that refuses a harmless reordering is one contributors learn to route around.

value.why: The guard checks a string on the interest saying its evaluator invokes no model. Owned by C02, that is the party with the interest classifying its own evaluator.
A recheck AT USE is a statement by the enforcement point at use time, not by the content that is rechecked.
The probe the result comes from, owned by the party that runs it.
The positive control on grant removal. Owned by the producer, it was the record whose grants are removed reporting that they were.
R-X15 argues the rule must be structural rather than asserted; while this field belonged to the producer it was the producer asserting its own grant inert.
